note: Which model runs which role. Stages hand over files, not conversation, so any role can run in any tool: for example the director in Antigravity on Gemini 4 Carbon, the builder in Claude Code on Opus.

roles.director: Angle, script, storyboard.json, the list of claims, and the final review. Needs the strongest reasoning; writes little.
roles.fact_checker: Lab scripts and the fact ledger. Needs strong maths and science; tries to break the director's claims.
roles.scene_builder: scenes/*.js from the storyboard with the engine kit, then lint, contact sheet and fixes. Mostly code volume.
roles.publisher: publish.json: titles, description, tags, call to action, thumbnail brief.

premium.use_when: New formats, new topics, anything where a wrong fact would be costly. The default.

balanced.use_when: Episodes of a series whose format the director already designed.

carbon.use_when: Working in Antigravity. Pick the model in Antigravity's own model menu for each stage; this file only records the intent.

scene_builder.model: claude-opus-5-5 or claude-sonnet-5-5, where Antigravity offers them; otherwise gemini-4-argon
